9. Tag the baseline and hand it to RWB-P1-E1015-APP, RWB-P1-E1015-OPS and every consuming service.
10. Draft the scheduler interface with the ready and status operations and the poll of the ACE batch record as the fallback; confirm with the bank platform team which path is live at go-live before the integration test.

edits.old: The exact JSON field names of the two freshness responses and the detail texts of the problem body are fixed here and confirmed with the consumers; the source/load time mapping behind `sourceExtractedAt` and `loadedAt` is the one ruled in GAP-0492 with ASM-0684, and the envelope attributes by GAP-0493 with ASM-0685.
edits.new: The exact JSON field names of the two freshness responses and the detail texts of the problem body are fixed here and confirmed with the consumers; the source/load time mapping behind `sourceExtractedAt` and `loadedAt` is the one ruled in GAP-0492 with ASM-0684, and the envelope attributes by GAP-0493 with ASM-0685. The CloudEvents envelope carries the attributes id, source, type, specversion, time, subject and datacontenttype, with subject set to the source system; the two events are keyed by sourceSystem and businessDate, and their seven payload fields carry the types fixed in the AsyncAPI document. The registry subject is named by the platform event owner, and the login is referenced as the rwb_source_data login (DP-02) until it is allocated. Before the ACE additions land, freshness is read from the batch-status view populated with synthetic batch rows; where the view is absent the data product is shown as not stamped and no date is inferred from a row count, a file or a view's data date. The fallback freshness source is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1507) and is named before the go-live decision.
